title: trojan box
tagline: A Trojan war themed mystery box game   *PLay to earn (Maximum 3300 ARES/Per time ) *Share to earn (Share to 5 platforms/ per day) *Supports VRF algorithm, configured randomness *Off-chain signature, decrease trading Gas fee
description:
It is a game developed based on the random offline signature of the Ethereum network. Trojan Box uses off-chain signature , to integrate authentication and trading into one same trade process, and use off-chain signature, and on-chain verified identity. This further enabled the safety environment for the game, and decreased the involved Gas fee.



At the same time, it is also a Trojan war themed mystery box game. The game is based on Greek ancient war, which enables you to select different Greek figures to join in the Play to Earn mode. In the whole process, you will discover the epic scenes in this game.
how_its_made:
Firstly, Trojan Box uses off-chain signature , to integrate authentication and trading into one same trade process, and use off-chain signature, and on-chain verified identity. This further enabled the safety environment for the game, and decreased the involved Gas fee.



Secondly, the game introduced Verifiable Random Function, VRF, to support the game settings with random amounts of rewards.  It also enables games to prevent malicious practices such as attacks, decrease energy consumption, and falsified signatures etc.



Finally, In order to reduce the storage on the chain, the game stores the image data on IPFS, and only stores the image hash summary on the chain.
